title: Reclaimed refrigerants.
officialText: Used refrigerants shall not be reused in a different owner’s equipment or appliances unless tested and found to meet the purity requirements of ARI 700. Contaminated refrigerants shall not be used unless reclaimed and found to meet the purity requirements of ARI 700.
